records.name: Dimension Cannon
records.effect: Short-range six-hit timespace Ki wave that launches and guard-breaks.
records.availability_note: Future Warrior acquisition is documented as a random PQ59 reward; the current character-user table lists Super Buu and customization users but does not negate Future Warrior acquisition.

records.name: Victory Cannon
records.effect: Fires a Ki wave and uses recoil to propel the user backward.

records.name: Force Shield
records.effect: Deploys a barrier that cancels Ki waves; holding the input consumes Ki to maintain it.

records.name: Blaster Meteor
records.effect: Creates a wide sphere of Ki blasts around the user, hitting up to eight times and launching nearby opponents.

notes: Dimension Cannon is Future Warrior-accessible through random PQ59 reward despite the current DBXV2 individual page listing cast/customization users. Force Shield remains cast-character-only in the reviewed current category evidence. Victory Cannon is Future Warrior-accessible via random PQ54 reward; Blaster Meteor is learned through Broly training.
